text: 1. A scanned copy of the information page of a valid passport;2. The highest academic degree certificate and diploma, as well as the transcript (for those who have not yet obtained the graduation certificate or diploma, a certificate of graduation from the school is required and a copy of the graduation certificate should be provided at the time of registration).3. University transcripts and HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) transcripts;4. Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above;5. Study Plan in China. The word count requirement for applying to a master's program is over 1,000 words, and for a doctoral program, it is over 1,500 words. Applicants can write in either Chinese or English. The content includes personal study and work experience, academic research achievements, research plans and personal development goals after graduation, etc.6. A list of published papers, abstracts, or other materials that can prove one's research capabilities;7. Id photo (2-inch blue-background, bareheaded photo);8. Self-introduction video in English or Chinese (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);9. Scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners"10. Applicants with work experience are requested to provide notarized work certificates. Other materials that can prove professional or personal background.11. Scanned copies of the "Economic Guarantee Letter" and its guarantee materials must be filled out in either Chinese or English.
